source.database: Human Reference Atlas, United Female v1.5
source.source: Visible Human Female, US National Library of Medicine; component references as recorded in HRA crosswalk
changes: Global centering and uniform scaling to 3.6 scene units; original source transforms preserved
Per-mesh simplification, independent GLB layers, stable original node identities
Named assemblies reference existing meshes; no duplicated geometry
Keep only explicitly VH_F-named source nodes; exclude Allen and Yao source components
Subset nodes, accessors and binary bufferViews without changing geometry bytes or transforms
Retain existing regional identifiers and assemblies; publish as a distinct optional reference

limitations: Only meshes explicitly identified as Visible Human Female (VH_F) are included; Allen and Yao components excluded
Reference anatomy is partial: no claim of a complete female skeleton, muscular or nervous system
Not an interchangeable mesh revision of the regional atlas; saved regional flashcards retain their original reference
No separately modelled gastric fundus, antrum or pylorus is present in these resources
